title: Intrinsic realization preserves flatness
statement: Let T be a scheme and B a finite commutative ring. Let M be a flat sheaf of modules over the fixed coefficient ring ULift B on the small pro-etale site of T. Its canonical associated-module-sheaf realization over the commutative constant ring sheaf B_T is flat for the sheafified sectionwise tensor product [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. The realization regards M as a module presheaf over constant scalars and sheafifies along the canonical scalar map into B_T, the commutative constant ring sheaf of [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf].

source.place: Tag 08FC, lemma-flat-eq; constant scalar realization in comparison Tor-amplitude proof step 1

proof.text: Restrict the realized module to constant scalars. The sheafification-unit isomorphism identifies it with the original flat module sheaf. Flatness is invariant under that isomorphism.

For any finite relation with scalar sections of B_T, intersect the covering sieves on which each coefficient lifts to a constant. Restrict the given relation on each object of this covering. Apply the fixed-coefficient flat local-relation theorem (B is finite, hence Noetherian). It gives a covering refinement, a finite factorization matrix and sections with the constant coefficient matrix relation zero.

Send the factorization matrix to the constant ring sheaf using its scalar unit. Scalar-linearity preserves the factorization of sections; naturality of the unit, preservation of finite sums and products, and the zero matrix relation give the required intrinsic scalar relation. The sieve of all such factorizations is downward closed by restriction. Covering transitivity proves that it covers. Apply the intrinsic local equational criterion to obtain IsFlatOnSite.

theorem intrinsicRealization_flat
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (M : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)))
    (hM : ObjectProperty.flat M) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
      (R := Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T B)
      ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization T B).obj M)
